description: This file defines the INetworkManager interface and related enums and structs for network management, including WiFi, IP, and interface status, within the WPEFramework project.

classes.name: INetworkManager
classes.description: Interface for network management operations, including interface control, IP configuration, WiFi management, and notifications.

classes.name: INetworkManager::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for network events such as interface state changes, IP changes, WiFi status updates.

methods.name: GetAvailableInterfaces
methods.description: Retrieves all available network interfaces.

methods.name: GetPrimaryInterface
methods.description: Gets the primary network interface used for external communication.

methods.name: SetInterfaceState
methods.description: Enables or disables a specified network interface.

methods.name: GetInterfaceState
methods.description: Gets the current state (enabled/disabled) of a specified interface.

methods.name: GetIPSettings
methods.description: Retrieves IP configuration for a specified interface.

methods.name: SetIPSettings
methods.description: Sets IP configuration for a specified interface.

methods.name: GetStunEndpoint
methods.description: Gets the STUN endpoint used for public IP detection.

methods.name: SetStunEndpoint
methods.description: Sets the STUN endpoint for public IP detection.

methods.name: GetConnectivityTestEndpoints
methods.description: Retrieves endpoints used for connectivity testing.

methods.name: SetConnectivityTestEndpoints
methods.description: Sets endpoints used for connectivity testing.

methods.name: IsConnectedToInternet
methods.description: Checks internet connectivity status.

methods.name: GetCaptivePortalURI
methods.description: Retrieves URL for captive portal authentication.

methods.name: GetPublicIP
methods.description: Retrieves the public IP address used for external communication.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Performs a network ping to a specified endpoint.

methods.name: Trace
methods.description: Performs a network trace to a specified endpoint.

methods.name: SetHostname
methods.description: Sets the DHCP hostname.

methods.name: StartWiFiScan
methods.description: Initiates an asynchronous WiFi scan.

methods.name: StopWiFiScan
methods.description: Stops ongoing WiFi scan.

methods.name: GetKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Retrieves list of known SSIDs.

methods.name: AddToKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Adds an SSID to the known list.

methods.name: RemoveKnownSSID
methods.description: Removes an SSID from the known list.

methods.name: WiFiConnect
methods.description: Connects to a specified WiFi network.

methods.name: WiFiDisconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from current WiFi network.

methods.name: GetConnectedSSID
methods.description: Retrieves information about the currently connected SSID.

methods.name: StartWPS
methods.description: Starts WPS pairing process.

methods.name: StopWPS
methods.description: Stops WPS pairing process.

methods.name: GetWifiState
methods.description: Retrieves current WiFi state.

methods.name: GetWiFiSignalQuality
methods.description: Gets WiFi signal quality metrics.

methods.name: GetSupportedSecurityModes
methods.description: Retrieves supported WiFi security modes.

methods.name: SetLogLevel
methods.description: Sets the plugin log level.

methods.name: GetLogLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the current log level.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the network manager plugin.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers for network notifications.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters from network notifications.
